Exactly 7 entries across 4 silent person-days: Marcus Liang 2026-03-13 (id 164), Diane Okonkwo 2026-06-05 (1150, 1161) and 2026-06-15 (1244, 1249, 1250), Marcus Liang 2026-06-29 (1409). _evidence.decoys: Single-surface near misses on every side: 77 entries whose timekeeper's only same-day footprint is a DM (public-channel search returns nothing), 13 entries supported only by one email, 59 supported only by a public channel message. A Gmail+public-channels survey reports 84 exceptions (7 true + 77 false); a Slack-only survey misreports the 13 email-only days. Every surface must be swept per person per day.
